sentences.text: Palo Alto -LRB- -LSB- ˌpæloʊ_ˈæltoʊ -RSB- ; -LSB- ˈpalo ˈalto -RSB- ; from palo , literally `` stick '' , colloquially `` tree '' , and alto `` tall '' ; meaning : `` tall tree '' -RRB- is a charter city located in the northwest corner of Santa Clara County , California , in the San Francisco Bay Area of the United States .	Santa Clara County	Santa Clara County, California	California	California	County	List of counties in California	Santa Clara	Santa Clara County, California	charter city	charter city	San Francisco Bay Area	San Francisco Bay Area

The city shares its borders with East Palo Alto , Mountain View , Los Altos , Los Altos Hills , Stanford , Portola Valley , and Menlo Park .	East Palo Alto	East Palo Alto, California	Mountain View	Mountain View, California	Los Altos	Los Altos, California	Los Altos Hills	Los Altos Hills, California	Stanford	Stanford, California	Portola Valley	Portola Valley, California	Menlo Park	Menlo Park, California
It is named after a coast redwood tree called El Palo Alto .	El Palo Alto	El Palo Alto	coast redwood tree	Sequoia sempervirens

Palo Alto was established by Leland Stanford Sr. when he founded Stanford University , following the death of his son , Leland Stanford Jr. .	Stanford	Stanford, California	Stanford University	Stanford University

The city includes portions of Stanford and is headquarters to a number of high-technology companies , including Hewlett-Packard -LRB- HP -RRB- , Space Systems/Loral , VMware , Tesla Motors , Ford Research and Innovation Center , PARC , IDEO , Skype , Palantir Technologies , and Houzz . It has also served as an incubator to several other high-technology companies such as Google , Facebook , Logitech , Intuit , Pinterest , and PayPal .	high-technology	technology	Google	Google	Facebook	Facebook	Logitech	Logitech	Intuit	Intuit	Pinterest	Pinterest	PayPal	PayPal
As of the 2010 census , the city 's total resident population is 64,403 .	2010 census	2010 United States Census
Palo Alto is one of the most expensive cities in the United States and its residents are amongst the highest educated in the country .
